name: thinkcards
description: Save, read, edit and tidy flashcards in your self-hosted ThinkCards deck.
long_description: Lets Claude add cards, read your decks and cards, rewrite or move cards (keeping review progress), delete cards, and set each deck's card format. Changes show up in ThinkCards after the next sync.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: List decks with card counts and formats

tools.name: update_cards
tools.description: Edit or move cards, keeping review progress

tools.name: configure_deck
tools.description: Create a deck or set its card format

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Your ThinkCards MCP endpoint. Filled in when you download from your ThinkCards app.

token.title: Token
token.description: The MCP_TOKEN secret from your Supabase project.
